AppError.description: The app refused the call (`APP_ERROR`, one of its declared errors) or the run trapped (`TRAP`).

BadRequest.description: The request is malformed (`BAD_REQUEST`), names a reserved method (`RESERVED_METHOD`), or carries an approval for another call (`WRONG_CHALLENGE`).

ConfirmRequired.description: `CONFIRM_REQUIRED`: approve the call with the passkey and send it again with `confirm`.

Forbidden.description: The caller may not call this method of this app (`FORBIDDEN`), or the app is read-only.

Gone.description: `UNSUPPORTED_ENGINE`: the app is an SDK 0.12 app, which this node no longer runs.

RateLimited.description: `RATE_LIMITED`: a public method's rate, or the node's limits.

Unauthorized.description: No valid session or API key, and the method is not public.

Unavailable.description: `UNAVAILABLE` or `TIMEOUT`: retry with the same idempotency key.

idempotencyKey.description: A retry with the same key is answered once, from the first run.

session.description: A passkey session's token or an API key, as `Authorization: Bearer`, inside the sealed channel.

info.description: Generated from the app's ABI (its `calimero:abi` section). Every request and answer travels inside the node's sealed channel, after the client has verified the node's attestation: use mero-js or calimero-client-py as the transport (the typed clients `meroctl app codegen` writes do), not plain HTTP. `POST /apps/{app}/methods/{name}` runs exactly as `POST /apps/{app}/intents` (a call) or `POST /apps/{app}/views` (a view) with the same `method`: the same authentication, gating, passkey step-up and limits. Errors are `{ error, message, details }`.
info.title: mero-sylence

get.description: Server-sent events: the committed events from log index `from`, then live ones. Each frame's `event` is the event's name, `id` is `<index>:<seq>` and `data` its fields as JSON. A subscriber receives only the events it is in the audience of.

post.description:
A call: runs as `POST /apps/{app}/intents` with `method: "addAction"`.

The ABI lists the app's errors for the whole app, not per method: any of them may answer `422 APP_ERROR`.
post.x-calimero-publisher-description: Adds an action item to a meeting and returns its id. Anyone who reaches the app.

post.description:
A call: runs as `POST /apps/{app}/intents` with `method: "appendSegments"`.

The ABI lists the app's errors for the whole app, not per method: any of them may answer `422 APP_ERROR`.
post.x-calimero-publisher-description:
Stores a batch of segments. Numbers already stored are skipped, so a
batch can be resent safely. The recorder only.

post.description:
A call: runs as `POST /apps/{app}/intents` with `method: "attachAudio"`.

The ABI lists the app's errors for the whole app, not per method: any of them may answer `422 APP_ERROR`.
post.x-calimero-publisher-description:
Gives the meeting its recording: blob `blob`, which the caller uploaded
to the app first. Replaces any earlier one (whose blob the node then
collects). The recorder only.

post.description:
A call: runs as `POST /apps/{app}/intents` with `method: "deleteMeeting"`.

The ABI lists the app's errors for the whole app, not per method: any of them may answer `422 APP_ERROR`.
post.x-calimero-publisher-description:
Deletes a meeting, its action items and up to 1,000 of its segments,
and returns how many segments remain. The meeting is gone from every
list at once; call again until `remaining` is 0. Its recorder or the
instance's owner.

post.description:
A call: runs as `POST /apps/{app}/intents` with `method: "dropSegments"`.

The ABI lists the app's errors for the whole app, not per method: any of them may answer `422 APP_ERROR`.
post.x-calimero-publisher-description:
Removes the segments numbered `fromSeq` up to (not including)
`beforeSeq`, at most 1,000 a call. The extension appends a transcript
redone after the call from `nextSeq` on, then drops the live one
(`fromSeq` 0), which marks the meeting `revised`; if the upload fails
halfway it drops what it sent instead. The recorder only.

post.description:
A call: runs as `POST /apps/{app}/intents` with `method: "editAction"`.

The ABI lists the app's errors for the whole app, not per method: any of them may answer `422 APP_ERROR`.
post.x-calimero-publisher-description: Rewrites an action item and who it is for. Anyone who reaches the app.

post.description:
A call: runs as `POST /apps/{app}/intents` with `method: "editSegment"`.

The ABI lists the app's errors for the whole app, not per method: any of them may answer `422 APP_ERROR`.
post.x-calimero-publisher-description: Corrects one segment's text. The recorder only.

post.description:
A call: runs as `POST /apps/{app}/intents` with `method: "endMeeting"`.

The ABI lists the app's errors for the whole app, not per method: any of them may answer `422 APP_ERROR`.
post.x-calimero-publisher-description:
Ends the recording. `durationMs` is the length the extension measured.
Ending an ended meeting changes nothing. The recorder only.

post.description:
A view: runs as `POST /apps/{app}/views` with `method: "getMeeting"`.

The ABI lists the app's errors for the whole app, not per method: any of them may answer `422 APP_ERROR`.
post.x-calimero-publisher-description: One meeting.

post.description:
A view: runs as `POST /apps/{app}/views` with `method: "insights"`.

The ABI lists the app's errors for the whole app, not per method: any of them may answer `422 APP_ERROR`.
post.x-calimero-publisher-description: A meeting's people insights, if any were saved.

post.description:
A view: runs as `POST /apps/{app}/views` with `method: "listActions"`.

The ABI lists the app's errors for the whole app, not per method: any of them may answer `422 APP_ERROR`.
post.x-calimero-publisher-description: A meeting's action items, oldest first.

post.description:
A view: runs as `POST /apps/{app}/views` with `method: "listMeetings"`.

The ABI lists the app's errors for the whole app, not per method: any of them may answer `422 APP_ERROR`.
post.x-calimero-publisher-description: Every meeting, newest first.

post.description:
A view: runs as `POST /apps/{app}/views` with `method: "myAccount"`.

The ABI lists the app's errors for the whole app, not per method: any of them may answer `422 APP_ERROR`.
post.x-calimero-publisher-description: The calling account.

post.description:
A view: runs as `POST /apps/{app}/views` with `method: "openActions"`.

The ABI lists the app's errors for the whole app, not per method: any of them may answer `422 APP_ERROR`.
post.x-calimero-publisher-description: Every action item not yet done, across meetings, newest meeting first.

post.description:
A call: runs as `POST /apps/{app}/intents` with `method: "removeAction"`.

The ABI lists the app's errors for the whole app, not per method: any of them may answer `422 APP_ERROR`.
post.x-calimero-publisher-description:
Removes an action item. Its author, the meeting's recorder or the
instance's owner.

post.description:
A call: runs as `POST /apps/{app}/intents` with `method: "removeAudio"`.

The ABI lists the app's errors for the whole app, not per method: any of them may answer `422 APP_ERROR`.
post.x-calimero-publisher-description: Removes the meeting's recording; the transcript stays. The recorder only.

post.description:
A call: runs as `POST /apps/{app}/intents` with `method: "renameMeeting"`.

The ABI lists the app's errors for the whole app, not per method: any of them may answer `422 APP_ERROR`.
post.x-calimero-publisher-description: Renames a meeting. The recorder only.

post.description:
A view: runs as `POST /apps/{app}/views` with `method: "search"`.

The ABI lists the app's errors for the whole app, not per method: any of them may answer `422 APP_ERROR`.
post.x-calimero-publisher-description:
Meetings whose title, and lines whose text, contain every word of
`query` (any case), newest meeting first and lines in order; at most
`limit` hits (1–100).

post.description:
A call: runs as `POST /apps/{app}/intents` with `method: "setActionDone"`.

The ABI lists the app's errors for the whole app, not per method: any of them may answer `422 APP_ERROR`.
post.x-calimero-publisher-description: Ticks an action item off, or back on. Anyone who reaches the app.

post.description:
A call: runs as `POST /apps/{app}/intents` with `method: "setInsights"`.

The ABI lists the app's errors for the whole app, not per method: any of them may answer `422 APP_ERROR`.
post.x-calimero-publisher-description:
Saves what the page worked out about each person, replacing what was
there. No people clears them. The recorder or the instance's owner.

post.description:
A call: runs as `POST /apps/{app}/intents` with `method: "setSpeakerName"`.

The ABI lists the app's errors for the whole app, not per method: any of them may answer `422 APP_ERROR`.
post.x-calimero-publisher-description:
Names speaker `label` ("Speaker 1") as `name` ("Eve") in this meeting;
an empty name removes it. The recorder or the instance's owner.

post.description:
A call: runs as `POST /apps/{app}/intents` with `method: "setSummary"`.

The ABI lists the app's errors for the whole app, not per method: any of them may answer `422 APP_ERROR`.
post.x-calimero-publisher-description: Replaces a meeting's summary (free text, may be empty). The recorder only.

post.description:
A call: runs as `POST /apps/{app}/intents` with `method: "startMeeting"`.

The ABI lists the app's errors for the whole app, not per method: any of them may answer `422 APP_ERROR`.
post.x-calimero-publisher-description: Starts recording a meeting and returns its id. The caller is its recorder.

post.description:
A view: runs as `POST /apps/{app}/views` with `method: "transcript"`.

The ABI lists the app's errors for the whole app, not per method: any of them may answer `422 APP_ERROR`.
post.x-calimero-publisher-description: Segments from number `fromSeq` on, in order, at most `limit` (1–500).
